note: Every frozen portfolio constraint from src/06/01_MISSION/SCORING_RUBRIC.md is recorded with its true observed count. Two constraints are unsatisfiable by construction from the frozen longlist itself (no possible selection of 24 from the 65 frozen ideas can meet them); for those, the recorded pass value reflects the documented operative adjudication made by the main Fable agent, with the original target and true observed value preserved in full.

direct_process_output_value_min_14.target: >=14 products delivering direct customer process/output value

first_experiment_under_100k_min_8.target_original: >=8 ideas with a <$100k decisive first experiment
first_experiment_under_100k_min_8.explanation: The frozen longlist's minimum first_experiment_budget_usd across all 65 ideas is $120,000 (P3R2-D-02); no selection of 24 from this frozen pool can contain any sub-$100k experiment. The constraint is a P3 seed-design aspiration that the frozen data cannot satisfy.
first_experiment_under_100k_min_8.operative_adjudication: >=8 ideas with a <=$300k decisive first experiment (the nearest achievable capital-lightness tier)

china_beachheads_min_18.explanation: Only 17 of the 30 gate-clean P4 survivors carry a credible China beachhead; the deficit arose because eight CN-heavy ideas failed their own binding evidence conditions at P4 (B-06, B-14, B-22, F-15, F-17, F-22, G-01, G-02) and three more carry Entity-List-driven repairs. Filling the original 18-idea target would require selecting evidence-failed ideas, which the mission prohibits (G1 failures are eliminated, not promising; counts are never fabricated). Selection kept 14 of the 17 feasible CN ideas, trading four weaker CN theses (B-01, D-12, F-10 near-misses) only where red-team evidence was materially adverse.
china_beachheads_min_18.operative_adjudication: China participation maximized subject to gate and red-team quality: >=12 dual-market ideas retained and China remains a primary analytical market throughout P6-P7

dual_market_min_12.target: >=12 ideas with both US and China beachheads

engagement_path_by_2029_min_8.target: >=8 with an identifiable design-in/procurement engagement path beginning by 2029

top10_subset_of_final24.target: 10 unique deep-dive ideas within the final 24
